# Nexo

> Versioned, curated Nexo context. Fetch only the documentation needed for the task.

Nexo AI Guide v1 | source sha256:646ce0460aed00bd00cc546d0b1f9cb62b2340721adf16358784b53fe21fe8ea
Python package 0.0.1; Rust workspace 0.1.0; API edition 0.1. These are component versions, not a stable 1.0 promise.

## Availability boundaries
- IMPLEMENTED [core]: Python interpreter and Rust/LLVM native compiler; records, explicit errors, contracts and tools. Package versions differ; do not infer a stable Nexo 1.0 release.
- IMPLEMENTED [diagnostics]: Versioned check --json diagnostics and conservative --effects analysis. Unknown/dynamic effects remain unknown; static checks do not grant permissions.
- IMPLEMENTED [agents]: Typed input/output, registered tools, approval before conversion, inherited cooperative cancellation/deadlines and reported token/money reservations. Counters trust configured prices/usage; they are not invoice guarantees or arbitrary-client metering.
- IMPLEMENTED [recovery]: Explicit version 2 operator grants enable encrypted bounded agent recovery and cross-process accounting. Native persistence is Linux AMD64 only. Durable inputs are text/none; result defaults and durable MCP calls are rejected. Uncertain dispatch fails closed; no exactly-once external-effect guarantee.
- IMPLEMENTED [shield]: Policy/API enforcement, dependency/dispatch ceilings and optional hardened containers/Linux workers exist. Kernel isolation requires supported host facilities; API-only tests prove no sandbox-escape guarantee. Generic workflow persistence remains rejected under Shield.
- IMPLEMENTED [telemetry]: NEXO_AGENT_TRACE=stderr explicitly enables payload-free OTLP JSON agent spans. No exporter runs by default. It is not universal automatic telemetry or a monitoring service.
- IMPLEMENTED [libraries]: The API catalog and working examples cover web/HTTP, SQL/document databases, streams, crypto, privacy, infrastructure and CI. Inspect exact signatures and connector/profile restrictions; an integration or emulator test is not a production certification.
- IMPLEMENTED [mcp]: Developer MCP server and agent MCP client exist. Published-spec interoperability and lifecycle/authorization completeness remain unverified; the roadmap audit is not completed by their presence.
- EXPERIMENTAL [web-target]: Browser playground and a platform-limited WebAssembly/web target exist. Do not describe them as production standalone WASI deployment or unrestricted native-library parity.
- PLANNED [interop-roadmap]: AI-native Phase 4 interoperability work (including a justified A2A adapter and standalone WASI investigation) and Phase 5 Nexo Sentinel validation remain future work. ml/ui/notify are not available modules.
- PLANNED [registry]: Signed packages/static registries exist, but an official registry service and reviewed-package ecosystem are not established.
- UNVERIFIED [operations]: Live cloud readiness, HA/SLO achievement, local Kubernetes compatibility, independent security audits, current provider prices and model-specific token parity require separate evidence. Existing infra adapters/examples do not prove these outcomes.
- EXPERIMENTAL [nexo-web-m1]: Python browser components/state/actions/scoped CSS; Rust browser driver and routing/APIs/HMR/SSR unavailable. Retrieve the conditional Nexo Web topic for UI tasks.
